$comment: The retired-forms ledger (S482). Ruling: scrml-support/user-voice-scrml.md S482 "⭐ RULED — every retirement / deprecation PR adds a retired-forms ledger row and migrates" — "every PR that retires or deprecates a syntax form must do both: 1. add a row to the retired-forms ledger (`compiler/retired-forms.json`): the old form, the new form, its tier, the error or warning code, and the ruling citation; 2. migrate the SPEC examples, or for a deprecated form, record the starting count, which then only goes down." HARD rows fail scripts/retired-forms-lint.ts outside labelled negatives, allow markers and the dated `pending` debt in scripts/retired-forms-baseline.json; SOFT rows ratchet per (row, file). `legacyMarker` rows feed scripts/bootstrap-conformance.ts LEGACY_MARKERS (in `order`). A `detector` is a regex over comment- and string-stripped scrml (per line; flag `m` = over the whole text) or a builtin of the lint; null = not detectable from text (the compiler enforces it). `enforcedBy`: which compiler emits one of the row's codes ("bootstrap", "impl#1", both), "lint-only" (no compiler emits a code — the gate alone holds the form), "none" (no code and no detector). `caseIdPattern`: for a row whose codes are generic, a conformance case is a labelled negative only when its id also matches.

rows.ruling: scrml-support/user-voice-scrml.md S469 (tape grant vocabulary; JS array methods refused)
rows.note: Text cannot tell a tape from a host array; a hit on host JS (a `_{}` body is never read) takes an allow marker. (b) counts a `.sort(` / `.reverse(` / `.fill(` / `.copyWithin(` call that is a whole statement (a plain receiver chain after `;` / `{` / `}` and only `;` / `}` / a line end after it) — a call whose value is used is legal. Not hits (#2101 r2, SPEC §63 known limits): a computed member call (`xs["push"](1)`), and a discarded call after any other boundary (`if (a) xs.sort()`).
